shots.line: Under the northern lights, 66 companies stand across Helsinki. Eight of them are currently hiring.
At Töölönlahdenkatu 2, Verda runs data centres and GPU hardware for training AI models, backed by a 189 million dollar Series B.
Nearby at Lapinlahdenkatu 16, Saidot builds an AI governance platform to track models, risks, and compliance.
On Pursimiehenkatu 29, Aiforia Technologies provides a cloud platform for AI medical image analysis in pathology.
At Henry Fordin katu 6, ReOrbit employs 126 people building sovereign satellites and software for national security.
From business software to space and climate, the city is open to explore.
